core_obligations: Reduce to the fibres over fields
Analyze the trace pairing orthogonal decomposition
difficulty_reason: A finite locally free morphism is etale iff its discriminant is empty: reduces to fibres by base-change commutation of the trace pairing, then the field case analyses the trace pairing space (A, Q) as the orthogonal sum of the (K_i, Q_{K_i}) with separability from the fields lemma and etaleness from the algebra lemma, the converse reading the argument backwards. Retained author proof at lines 761-787.

compared.note: Founding discriminant-etale equivalence; distinct from lemma-different-ramification (different sheaf).
